# WhiteMatterAnalysis GPU

> GPU-accelerated diffusion MRI (dMRI) streamline tractography registration, spectral fiber clustering, and Slicer-free ORG white matter parcellation (CLI, Python SDK, and Docker/Apptainer).

## Core Entrypoints

- [README.md](README.md): Overview, RTX 3090 benchmarks, and quick start across CLI, Python SDK, and Docker/Apptainer.
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): Machine-readable integration contract, JSON CLI probes, I/O schemas, exit codes, and resource controls for AI agents.
- [pyproject.toml](pyproject.toml): PEP 621 package metadata, dependencies, optional extras (`gpu`, `h5`, `dev`), and `wma` console script.
- [Dockerfile](Dockerfile): Multi-target container build (`gpu` default CUDA 12.4 / optional CUDA 12.8, plus lightweight `cpu` target).

## Code Map

- [whitematteranalysis/pipelines/org.py](whitematteranalysis/pipelines/org.py): Python SDK (`ORGParcellationPipeline`, `ORGConfig`, `SubjectResult`, `BatchResult`, `parcellate_subject`, `parcellate_batch`) and single-process ORG engine.
- [whitematteranalysis/cli.py](whitematteranalysis/cli.py): Unified `wma` CLI (`doctor --json`, `list --json`, `org`, `harden`, `register`, `cluster`, `build-atlas`, `remove-outliers`, `separate`, `download-atlas`).
- [whitematteranalysis/transform.py](whitematteranalysis/transform.py): Pure-Python/VTK ITK affine, 3D cubic BSpline, and Composite (`.tfm`/`.h5`) transform reader and polydata hardening.
- [whitematteranalysis/gpu/](whitematteranalysis/gpu/__init__.py): CUDA/Triton kernels (distance, embedding, split-C centroids, `O(N + R^3)` nonrigid B-spline backward, batched `kmeans2`), vectorized CPU backend, and `.npz` atlas caching.
- [whitematteranalysis/atlases.py](whitematteranalysis/atlases.py): Multi-atlas resolution and validation (`org`, `east-west`, `naba`).

## Technical Docs

- [doc/acceleration.md](doc/acceleration.md): GPU/CPU acceleration architecture and Benchmarks A–H.
- [doc/command-line-reference.md](doc/command-line-reference.md): Complete argument reference for `bin/` CLI scripts.
- [doc/bundles.md](doc/bundles.md): Anatomical white matter tract definitions.
- [NOTICE](NOTICE): Upstream provenance and contributor attribution (`SlicerDMRI/whitematteranalysis`, `NeuroDMRI/whitematteranalysis_gpu`, `xiaji`).
